text: 根据中国保险行业协会披露信息统计发现，9月以来，已有5家险企披露增资计划。今年前三季度，共有13家中小型保险机构（包括人身险公司、财险公司和再保险公司）披露增资计划，计划注册资本增加规模合计约134亿元。受访专家表示，多家险企近期披露增资计划，主要受低利率环境、新会计准则实施、行业业务结构转型等因素影响。（证券日报）
text_en: According to statistics from information disclosed by the Insurance Association of China, since September, 5 insurers have disclosed capital increase plans. In the first three quarters of this year, a total of 13 small and medium-sized insurance institutions (including life insurers, property insurers, and reinsurers) disclosed capital increase plans, with a planned total increase in registered capital of about 13.4 billion yuan. Experts interviewed said that the recent capital increase plans disclosed by multiple insurers are mainly affected by factors such as the low interest rate environment, the implementation of new accounting standards, and the transformation of the industry's business structure. (Securities Daily)
